documents.title: Board Meeting - Financial Results/Other business matters
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results during an earnings conference call, highlighting a challenging operating environment marked by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material costs, and geopolitical uncertainties. Despite these headwinds, the company achieved a 35% year-on-year growth in quarterly revenue from operations at Rs. 532 crore and a 36% year-on-year increase in EBITDA to Rs. 89 crore. Management noted that raw material availability has improved and expressed confidence in ramping up utilization of newly commissioned NPK capacities to drive further growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than Rs. 500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a top-line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth in FY27 to be in the range of 35% to 40%.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that fertilizer offtake accelerated across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season following the monsoon revival.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP and government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework are creating a favourable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.
demand_outlook.quote: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry with comfortable domestic stock levels and a favourable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure even if demand were to soften.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity stands at 120,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: The new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
capex_expansion.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

capex_expansion.claim: So far, no additional capex or expansion plans beyond the implemented ones have been planned.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of approximately 7%-8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs has been passed on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices rose from around Rs. 65,000 to Rs. 70,000 per tonne in April to almost Rs. 1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 grew by 59% YoY to Rs. 90 crore, supported by operating leverage and stable cost management.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming input prices driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, and higher logistic and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA per ton was in the range of Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the quarter stood at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA at the Meghnagar manufacturing facility.
Fertilizer production for Q4 FY26 reached 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants maintained healthy utilization, with certain units operating above 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: Total production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT, supported by high demand across markets.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of equity shares from Rs. 10 to Rs. 2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year during the April-May 2026 period.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch occurred where domestic demand slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia capacity agreement will start after two years in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains focused on disciplined execution and long-term value creation through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.
management_commitments.quote: Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: The benefits of the recent capacity expansion are expected to meaningfully reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to the best utilization of its manufacturing facilities.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to the best utilization of our manufacturing facilities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
